description: List gas stations around a latitude/longitude in Quebec with current prices in ¢/L, ranked by value (the default: price plus a 1¢/L-per-km distance penalty, the best answer to "where should I fill up"), by price, or by distance. Each station comes with name, brand, address, city, distance and all three fuel prices, so this is also the way to look up a specific station or brand: search around its location with sort=distance and pick it out by name or brand. There is no geocoding tool: turn a postal code, address, landmark or neighbourhood into approximate coordinates yourself. If the user gives no location at all, ask for one instead of guessing. Returns at most 10 stations within 30 km; for a whole-city summary use get_city_prices.

fuel_type.description: Which price ranks the stations: ordinaire = regular, super = premium, diesel = diesel. All three prices are returned either way.

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees (Quebec: 44 to 63). Estimate it yourself from a postal code, address or landmark.

limit.description: Number of stations to return, default 5, max 10

lng.description: Longitude in decimal degrees (Quebec: -80 to -57). Estimate it yourself from a postal code, address or landmark.

radius_km.description: Search radius in km, default 10, max 30 (larger values are rejected)

sort.description: value = price + 1¢/L per km of distance (default); price = cheapest first; distance = closest first

name: find_cheapest_stations
title: Find stations near a point
